newsitem.title: FINLAND: LEMMINKAINEN HAS FIM 350 MLN NEW ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: LEMMINKAINEN HAS FIM 350 MLN NEW ORDERS.

text.p: Finnish construction group Lemminkainen Oy said in a statement on Friday it had won new orders worth a total of 350 million markka from Russia, Germany, Lithuania and Zambia.
Lemminkainen said it would lead a project to build a cargo terminal in Moscow. For Lemminkainen, this project will be worth 90 million markka.
It will also build for about 25 million markka a building for radio and telvision operations in Siberia.
In Germany, Lemminkainen will for 90 million markka lead a project to build an icehockey stadium.
In Lithuania, Lemminkainen signed a letter of intent to build a 70 million markka wastewater treatment plant.
In Zambia, Lemminkainen will share a 155 million markka road repair project with Danish Hojgaard & Schultz A/S.

Lemminkainen said it expected the share of international operations to rise to about 25 percent in 1997 from 19 percent in 1995. Figures for 1996 were not yet available, a company spokeswoman said by telephone.
